pages.text: $(bold)Obtaining$() (Iron's Spells crossover):$(li)Melt $(bold)Raw Mithril$() ($(bold)irons_spellbooks:raw_mithril$()) - $(bold)30 mB each$()$(li)Melt $(bold)Mithril Scrap$() ($(bold)irons_spellbooks:mithril_scrap$()) - $(bold)20 mB each$()$(li)Melt $(bold)Mithril Ingot$() ($(bold)irons_spellbooks:mithril_ingot$()) - $(bold)90 mB per ingot$()$(br2)One unit = $(bold)90 mB$()$(br2)Usable for: $(bold)tool head / binding / handle / bow limb / grip$()$(br2)Tier: $(bold)T3$(); the head mines at $(bold)netherite level$() (the ore itself needs a netherite pick).$(br2)Stats: head 340 durability / $(bold)9.5 speed$() / 3.1 attack; handle +8% attack speed; limb $(bold)+0.20 accuracy$() / +0.12 draw speed; grip +0.15 accuracy. $(bold)Hard, accurate and light - but low durability.$()

$(bold)Traits$():$(li)$(l:trait_focus)Focus$() (leveled): your casting $(bold)cannot be interrupted$() while held, and each level adds 5% cast speed$(li)Arcane Conduction: strengthens inscribed spells and boosts spell damage$(li)$(l:trait_spell_break)Spell Break$() (no levels): comes with a $(bold)level 1 Counterspell$()$(br2)$(italic)Mithril is a mage's metal: light, precise and quick - just do not expect it to take a beating.$()
